seoTitle: Video Frame Grabber: Save Stills at Exact Timestamps
metaDescription: Save still frames from a video as PNG or JPG at timestamps or at regular intervals, with a ZIP of all. Private, browser only.
intro: Pulls still images out of a video at times you list, or every N seconds, in full resolution as PNG or JPG.
why:
To get a thumbnail, a screenshot for a bug report or a frame for a storyboard you need an exact moment. Enter timestamps like 1.5, 0:10 or 1:02:03, or set an interval. The player lets you find the time first.

Each frame is saved at the video size. Many frames are also offered as one ZIP. No upload happens.
howTo: Choose the video and find your moments in the player.
Type the timestamps, or set an interval in seconds.
Pick PNG or JPG and press Process.
Download single frames or the ZIP.

faq.a: It is the frame the browser shows at that time, which is within one frame of the request.
PNG is lossless and larger. JPG is smaller.
Up to 200 frames in interval mode.
Use a small interval, but memory limits apply for very long videos.
